protocol.scope: Every archived LLM round request in the complete 17-route online portfolio.
protocol.intervention: Permute all target outcomes unrevealed at the audited decision state while preserving revealed outcomes, candidate identifiers, public candidate attributes, source evidence, and protocol settings.
protocol.primary_success_rule: Every state must exactly preserve the public-candidate fingerprint, source prior, candidate menu, menu diagnostics, and full current-code LLM prompt after hidden-label permutation; every archived prompt must independently match its recorded SHA-256. Exact reconstruction of historical prompt bytes is reported as a code-version diagnostic rather than a primary endpoint.
protocol.failure_policy: Any mismatch fails the audit and remains in the report. No route or round may be removed after inspection.
protocol.claim_boundary: This implementation audit tests non-interference on archived states. It does not measure scientific reasoning quality, transfer efficacy, or prospective generalization.
